title: DotfilesComparisonRun
description: One hypothesis, two or more legs. MVP is two full-tree git SHAs. Optional overlay lets a later fan mode swap flagged files without a new product. Metrics are written after the run; this schema is the record, not a runtime loader.

comparisonId.description: Stable id for this experiment. All Pino lines and cache records for the legs share it.

hypothesis.description: What the human thinks will improve (quality, latency, or tokens).

classifications.description: Tags for dashboard query and interview rollup.

scenarioId.description: Id of a committed scenario (for example react-node-monorepo).

model.description: Default model for every leg unless a leg overrides.

overlay.description: Exception: take these paths from another SHA. MVP omits this. Fan mode uses it to build four permutations.

metrics.description: Filled after the leg runs. Omit on the input fixture.

treeSha.description: Git commit used as the entire tree unless overlay is set.
